description: Fields required for a participant submission form in the YBB Platform. Divided into 4 sections: Personal Details, Contact Information, Entry Information, Miscellaneous.
source: Derived from remote DB schema (participants, participant_essays, participant_subthemes tables)
note: Documents are handled in a separate flow and are not part of this form.

sections.description: Basic personal and background information about the participant

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: Enter your full legal name exactly as it appears on your official documents

fields.label: ID Card Name
fields.hint: The shorter version of your name that fits on your ID card — use this if your full name is too long for an official name tag or ID

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Select your date of birth

fields.label: Gender
fields.hint: Select the option that best describes you

fields.country_reference: country ISO code (e.g. ID) from the countries table
fields.label: Nationality
fields.hint: Select your nationality from the list. The country name, code, and flag will be saved automatically.

fields.label: Home Address
fields.hint: Your permanent home / origin address

fields.label: Current Address
fields.hint: Your current domicile address, if different from your home address

fields.label: Occupation
fields.hint: E.g. Student, Employee, Freelancer

fields.label: Education Level
fields.hint: E.g. Senior High School, Undergraduate (S1), Graduate (S2)

fields.label: Institution / School / Company
fields.hint: Name of your school, university, or place of work

fields.label: Major / Field of Study
fields.hint: Your academic major or field of study

fields.label: Organizations
fields.hint: List any organizations, communities, or clubs you are currently or were previously involved in

fields.label: Experience
fields.hint: Describe relevant experience such as leadership roles, volunteering, research, or notable projects

fields.label: Achievements
fields.hint: List any awards, competitions won, or notable accomplishments

fields.label: CV / Resume
fields.hint: Upload your latest CV or resume in PDF format

fields.label: Medical / Disease History
fields.hint: Disclose any medical conditions or allergies that the organizing team should be aware of during the event. Type 'None' if not applicable.

fields.label: T-Shirt Size
fields.hint: Select your t-shirt size for event merchandise

sections.description: The participant's own phone number and emergency contact details

fields.country_reference: country ISO code from the countries table — used to derive the dial code and flag stored in DB
fields.label: Phone Number
fields.hint: Select your country code first, then enter your phone number without the country code (e.g. 08123456789 → 8123456789)

fields.label: Instagram Username
fields.hint: Enter your Instagram username without the @ symbol

fields.label: Emergency Contact Name
fields.hint: Full name of the person to contact in case of emergency

fields.label: Relationship to Emergency Contact
fields.hint: E.g. Parent, Sibling, Spouse, Friend

fields.country_reference: country ISO code from the countries table — used to derive the dial code and flag stored in DB
fields.label: Emergency Contact Phone Number
fields.hint: Select the country code for your emergency contact, then enter their phone number without the country code

sections.description: Program-specific information: participation category, subtheme selection, and essay answers

fields.label: Program
fields.hint: The program you are registering for — typically pre-selected from the registration page

fields.label: Participation Category
fields.hint: Select 'Fully Funded' if you are applying for a scholarship. Select 'Self-Funded' if you will cover your own participation costs.

fields.label: Subtheme / SDG Focus Area
fields.hint: Select the SDG (Sustainable Development Goal) topic that best aligns with your interests and essay. Each program offers a set of available subthemes.
example_options_jys2026: SDG 8 – Decent Work and Economic Growth

fields.note: Each program defines its own essay questions (program_essays). Answers are stored per question in participant_essays linked by program_essay_id.

example_questions_jys2026.label: Essay Title
example_questions_jys2026.hint: Write a concise title for your essay (max 150 words)

example_questions_jys2026.label: Main Essay
example_questions_jys2026.hint: As a youth leader, how have you contributed — or how do you plan to contribute — to advancing solutions within your chosen SDG focus area? Elaborate on your ideas, experiences, or initiatives (max 800 words)

example_questions_jys2026.label: References
example_questions_jys2026.hint: List the references used in your essay, formatted consistently (e.g. APA, MLA) (max 250 words)

sections.description: Referral source, social media proof, and ambassador referral code

fields.label: How Did You Hear About Us?
fields.hint: Select where you heard about the program

fields.label: Account / Person Name
fields.hint: If you heard about us through a specific social media account or person, enter their name or username here

fields.label: Twibbon Post Link
fields.hint: Paste the URL of your twibbon post on Instagram or other social media platforms

fields.label: Requirement Evidence Link
fields.hint: Paste the Google Drive or social media link containing your required post (e.g. story screenshot or repost)

fields.label: Ambassador Referral Code
fields.hint: If you were referred by a YBB ambassador, enter their referral code here (optional)
